subject.title: fix(infra): make exec-approvals lock ownership filesystem-safe

question: Which of the two overlapping open PRs should be the single canonical landing branch for the exec-approvals nonce-lock repair?
rationale: Both branches represent the same central implementation, but this draft is a newer rebase while the earlier PR carries the original live reproduction and proof; selecting one needs an owner decision before duplicate review proceeds.

options.title: Adopt this rebased branch
